mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates and reduces valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has been above 4.5% for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive equity returns as corporate earnings prospects improve over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression has a negative coefficient.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.5%), a decline in the unemployment rate over the past month signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE > 5.5 and UNRATE declines by more than 0.2 percentage points in one month, the S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS has increased for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 105 for two consecutive months, it signals strong manufacturing activity and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO has been above 105 for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A rising CPIAUCSL (indicating high inflation) and falling FEDFUNDS (indicating accommodative policy) together signal a policy dilemma that increases equity risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising CPIAUCSL and falling FEDFUNDS fails to produce negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During a housing market downturn (HOUST < 1000 thousand units), a rebound in housing starts signals a recovery in the housing sector that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where HOUST < 1000 and HOUST rebounds (increases > 0.5% in one month), the S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.
